title: U-KAN Makes Strong Backbone for Medical Image Segmentation and Generation
mechanism: Conv U-Net whose deeper stages tokenize features and process them with Kolmogorov-Arnold layers (learnable spline activations), giving higher accuracy at lower compute.
adaptation: 1-channel, 512 px. Use as the efficient-model member of the benchmark (edge deployment for WattCycle). Little expected effect on 1 px cracks, because the KAN blocks sit at low resolution.
min_experiment: One run per fold in the shared benchmark protocol; report test-49 and E1 metrics plus FLOPs/FPS against the house model. Kill: below house on crack relF1@2 by more than 0.02, then keep only for the efficiency axis.
evidence: R: better accuracy at lower compute than U-Net/UNeXt baselines on BUSI, GlaS and CVC. U-Bench ranks it in the U-Score top 10 (in-domain #8, zero-shot #3).

alt_notes.adaptation: Suite member, 1-channel 2D 512 px, same folds; shallow stages that carry 1-2 px crack detail are unchanged, so expected crack gain near zero.
alt_notes.min_experiment: U-KAN 5 folds v house; benchmark row only; kill for score if no CV metric +0.01.
